'''The Dark Begin Finding A New Generator v 1''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[The Dark]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-18448">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/18448 Begin Finding A New Generator v 1], DeckTech (Darth Vader "The Dark" Lord of The Sith, 19 August 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/18448/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/18448/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020224752/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/18448/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[The Dark]]
* '''Published:''' 19 August 2001 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''Begin Finding A New Generator v 1''
* '''Format:''' [[Episode I Closed Environment]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone / We'll Need A New One|Cor-L-thehyperdrivegeneratorsgone.gif|label=The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Podrace Prep|Tat-L-podraceprep.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:EP1 THGG Dark LS 2001 DeckTech.txt |Download]]
* '''Strategy:''' A Closed Format Episode 1 deck based on The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone.

== Original post ==

'''Begin Finding A New Generator v 1'''
* '''Author:''' Darth Vader "The Dark" Lord of The Sith
* '''Published:''' August 19, 2001
* '''Rating:''' 3.5
* '''Description:''' A Closed Format Episode 1 deck based on The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone.

=== Strategy ===

I will post the Strategy in about 2 hours. I have togo and will be back to post so please don't take off right now. The strategy's is pretty simple actually, just look at The objective's game text at Big D's website.
